{{Quote|Karsim, Naja, Eckerd&hellip; that whole squad has simply vanished.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="The Surgeons" />}}
'''Naja''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Naja was later recruited into a [[Special Forces black ops program|black ops program]] run by the Army's [[Republic Special Forces Division]], becoming a member of the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] known as the [[Surgeons]]. However, the squad was eventually convicted of war crimes and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berrun]] after it started hunting the families of enemy targets.

==Biography==
[[File:Fideltin_Rusk.png|thumb|right|200px|Sergeant Fideltin Rusk, Karsim's commanding officer]]
{{Quote|They were good soldiers. Far better than any of the others I've had under my command.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="The Surgeons" />}}
A [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Bad Intel">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Bad Intel}}</ref> Naja<ref name="Vanished">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Vanished}}</ref> served in a [[Surgeons|squad]] under the [[Commander/Legends|command]] of the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]]. The [[Squad/Legends|squad's]] first [[Attack on an Imperial outpost|mission]] was to free several Republic [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war from an [[Imperial outpost (prison camp)|Imperial outpost]]; however, intelligence on the mission was bad, forcing the squad to fight through more enemy forces than it expected. Despite its disadvantage, the squad was able to rescue all of the prisoners and escape with heavy injuries but no [[Death/Legends|fatalities]].<ref name="Bad Intel" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following that mission, Naja was among the squad members who were recruited into the [[Republic Special Forces Division]]'s [[Special Forces black ops program|black ops program]], and the squad&mdash;which included fellow veterans [[Karsim]] and [[Eckerd]]&mdash;was tasked by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]] with the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of Imperial leaders. The squad, which became known as the "Surgeons," soon began to go after its targets' families. When this came to light, Naja and the others were arrested for war crimes and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in a [[Berrun detention center|detention center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berrun]] with life sentences.<ref name="The Surgeons" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Good soldiers know what acceptable targets are. This wouldn't have happened on my watch.|Sergeant Rusk|<ref name="The Surgeons" />}}
A loyal soldier, Naja's [[Time/Legends|time]] in the Special Forces black ops program turned the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] into a killer who no longer respected the moral code of warfare. Sergeant Rusk was disturbed to learn that his former squad mates had crossed the line and targeted [[Gender/Legends|women]] and children, and was disappointed that Naja and the others&mdash;whom he had considered the best soldiers to ever serve under him&mdash;had changed so much.<ref name="The Surgeons" />

==Behind the scenes==
Naja was mentioned in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. At one point in the game's development, Naja was intended to appear either in person or in a conversation, as the soldier is listed in ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} NPC files.<ref name="The Surgeons" />
